pins.definition: An outer garment covering the body from the waist to the ankles, with a separate part for each leg.
A piece of clothing that covers the lower body and each leg separately.
An outer garment covering each leg separately, from the waist to the ankles.

situation: A tailor on a sunny afternoon lays out a finished pair of trousers flat on a large wooden cutting table to inspect the dual leg channels.
subject: clothing covering each leg separately
brief: A pair of wool trousers rests flat on a weathered oak table, clearly showing the waistband and two distinct, separate leg tubes running parallel down the frame. Natural light from a side window falls across the fabric, revealing the weave and the two individual leg openings.
